hypotheses.title: Turnover-Compressed Rolling VWAP Execution Discount Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: When a stock closes below its intraday volume-weighted average price relative to its close ((vwap - close) / close > 0), market-on-close sellers dumped liquidity at an excessive execution discount. In Batch 297, this rolling VWAP discount delivered an exceptional Sharpe of 1.62 and Sub-universe Sharpe of 0.93 with zero correlation flags, but turnover was 43.85% under a 5-day decay window. Lengthening the linear decay horizon to 15 days dampens high-frequency rebalancing noise, compressing turnover to ~16-18% to propel Fitness from 0.69 to well over 1.15 with 100% matrix coverage in pv1.
confounders: Sustained institutional liquidation over multi-week horizons that breaks short-term mean-reversion
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if turnover-compressed VWAP discount yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 15-day linear decay of 60-day rolling rank of intraday VWAP execution discount.

hypotheses.title: Rolling 60-Day Operating Earnings Yield Inflection
hypotheses.economic_rationale: operating_income (fundamental dataset, statutory SEC corporate filings) captures audited core business operating profitability before non-operating distortions. Dividing by cap yields the classic Operating Profitability Yield (Novy-Marx, 2013). In Batch 297, fundamental balance-sheet yield demonstrated ideal turnover of 14.37% and Fitness > 0.50. Replacing static book equity with dynamic operating earnings eliminates value traps and targets Sharpe > 1.30 while maintaining the 14% turnover corridor and zero analyst4 correlation.
confounders: One-off restructuring charges or non-recurring operating cost accruals that distort quarterly operating earnings
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if operating income yield yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of 60-day rolling rank of operating income to market capitalization.

hypotheses.title: Rolling 60-Day Low-Beta Defensive Quality Flight
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Empirical asset pricing confirms that low-beta equities systematically generate higher risk-adjusted returns than lottery-like high-beta stocks due to institutional leverage constraints (Black, 1972; Frazzini & Pedersen, 2014). Using beta_last_60_days_spy (model51, 98% coverage in TOP3000) inside the proven rolling rank framework isolates equities whose market sensitivity is at a 60-day historical low relative to their subindustry peers, capturing institutional flight to quality.
confounders: Sudden violent macroeconomic market rallies where high-beta speculative equities temporarily lead
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if rolling low-beta yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of 60-day rolling rank of inverted 60-day SPY market beta.
